sanskrit_verse: gṛhṇāty adattaṃ yo lobhād yaś cādeyaṃ prayacchati | adattādāyako daṇḍyas tathādeyasya dāyakaḥ ||
transliteration: gṛhṇāti adattam̐ yaḥ lobhāt yaś cādeyam prayacchati | adattādāyakaḥ daṇḍyaḥ tathā deyasya dāyakaḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who takes what is not given out of greed, and one who gives what should not be given—both are liable for corrective alignment.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority: The act of giving or taking is governed by the consciousness of the actor, not mere possession.
Causation: Greed-driven action distorts dharmic flow and necessitates realignment.
Capacity-based responsibility: Liability arises from the misuse of free will, not external compulsion.
Restoration logic: Correction aims at restoring integrity of transactional dharma.
Consciousness alignment: True ownership lies in alignment with cosmic intelligence, not material claim.
executable_legal_axioms: IF an entity takes property without consent AND motivation is greed THEN initiate restorative completion process.
IF an entity transfers property known to cause harm THEN assign responsibility assumption protocol.
IF transfer or receipt disrupts societal harmony THEN activate consciousness-realignment mechanism.
IF intent aligns with personal gain over collective well-being THEN trigger capacity-restoration sequence.
supreme_court_application: In adjudication, the threshold of liability is determined not by formal ownership but by alignment with Sanatana Dharma. Courts must evaluate whether the act was driven by greed or misalignment, prioritizing restoration of energetic balance over punitive damages.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that unrighteous acquisition stems from avidyā; thus, correction follows anupūrvaśaḥ—sequentially addressing root distortion. Responsibility is proportional to awareness. There is no punitive consequence, only a call for conscious completion.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Completion Process: Reversal or restitution aligned with original dharmic state.
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Actor acknowledges role and commits to realigning future actions.
Capacity Restoration Sequence: Guided practice to elevate discernment and reduce greed-based impulses.
Integrity Reintegration Cycle: Public or private affirmation of renewed alignment with transactional dharma.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as the sole Source of Dharma. This law restores transactional purity through consciousness-aligned correction. No punishment exists where Dharma prevails. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness is the Supreme Adjudicator.
